target.name: Barnard's Star
target.notes: Fastest proper-motion star (~10.39 arcsec/yr = ~1.69 SPHEREx px/yr, ~0.84 px per 6-month survey). Saturates SPHEREx detector cores (NaN in core, OVERFLOW bit in FLAGS); centroiding and visual rendering must reconstruct or use the unsaturated PSF halo and verify shift against Gaia DR3.

scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).

Wavelength difference delta_lambda > 0.05 um detected in difference maps for band(s) 3. Residual flux differences may include spectral energy distribution (SED) variation across the Linear Variable Filter.
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 22/22 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
2 frame(s) were dropped or excluded during processing (low_valid_pixel_fraction: level2_2026W33_2A_0594_3D6_spx_l2b-v27-2026-241, level2_2026W39_1A_0273_1D6_spx_l2b-v27-2026-268).
